hypotheses.A1_small_newline_edits_match_semantic_st: At scale 0.125, state-norm top-32 mean fidelity is at least 0.97.
hypotheses.A2_state32_fidelity_improves_as_scale_sh: Mean state-norm top-32 fidelity is nonincreasing with intervention scale.
hypotheses.A3_small_scale_repairs_the_worst_conditi: Scale 0.125 state-norm top-32 minimum fidelity exceeds scale 1.0 minimum by at least 0.10.
hypotheses.A4_pattern32_improves_as_scale_shrinks: Mean pattern-change top-32 fidelity is nonincreasing with intervention scale.
hypotheses.A5_fisher_target_energy_is_locally_quadr: Across scales 0.125 through 0.5, target Fisher energy divided by scale squared has coefficient of variation at most 0.10.
hypotheses.A6_state_rule_still_beats_recency_at_sma: At scale 0.125, state-norm top-32 exceeds recency top-32 by at least 0.20 mean fidelity.
hypotheses.A7_state16_remains_less_robust_than_stat: At every scale, state-norm top-16 has lower mean fidelity than top-32.
hypotheses.A8_large_scale_exposes_nonlinear_metric_: At scale 1.5, at least one method-condition fidelity is negative.
hypotheses.A9_scale_does_not_fully_explain_semantic: Even at scale 0.125, newline state-norm top-32 mean fidelity remains at least 0.02 below the semantic state-norm top-32 reference.
hypotheses.A10_source_geometry_and_effect_scale_bot: A1 and A9 are both supported: shrinking helps materially but does not close the semantic gap.
